How we work

Four steps, no surprises

Every engagement runs the same way, so you always know what happens next and what it costs.

1

Scope

A short paid discovery. You leave with a spec, a timeline and a fixed price — whether or not you build with us.

2

Design

Clickable prototype before a line of production code. You approve how it looks and how it feels.

3

Build

Two-week sprints with a working build in your hands at the end of each one. No black box.

4

Ship

We handle store review, launch and the first months of iteration while real users arrive.

How engagements are priced

Discovery is a fixed fee. After that, most projects run as a fixed price per phase, agreed before the phase starts. Longer partnerships can run as a monthly retainer instead.

You own everything we produce — designs, source code, accounts and infrastructure. There is no lock-in and no licence to keep paying.

What we don't do

  • ✦Rescue projects we didn't scope, without a paid review first
  • ✦Fixed-price builds from a one-paragraph brief
  • ✦Work we can't do well — we'll say so and point you elsewhere

Tell us what you're building and we'll be straight with you

A short conversation is usually enough to know whether this is a fit.
